g:HTMLPanel.p: Button for actions, AnchorButton for links that look like buttons.

d:Example.heading: Types
d:Example.description: `type` takes a `ButtonType`. Buttons without a type are `btn-light`, so a forgotten type is still visible.

d:Example.heading: Outline
d:Example.description: The `*_OUTLINE` types draw only the border until hover.

d:Example.heading: Sizes and states
d:Example.description: `size` is `SMALL` or `LARGE`; `enabled="false"` disables a button and `active` shows it pressed.

d:Example.heading: Icons and links
d:Example.description: `icon` takes the name of a Bootstrap Icon (`IconTypeBI`), and `iconPosition` puts it after the text. `AnchorButton` is an `<a>` with an `href` or a `targetHistoryToken`.

d:Example.heading: Handling clicks
d:Example.description: `addClickHandler` runs your code when the button is clicked.
